# Bring the Broken Toaster. Stay for Coffee.
## Our first Fix-It Saturday at St. Ansgar

**Saturday, December 5, 2026 · 9 a.m.–1 p.m.**  
**Fellowship Hall, St. Ansgar Lutheran Church · Minneapolis, MN**  
**Enter by the alley door, where there’s a ramp.**

A while back, Marv Okafor fixed my 1970s Hamilton Beach mixer in twenty minutes in the church kitchen. That’s where this idea began. Too much gets thrown away when all it needs is a screw, a new cord, or somebody who knows what to look for.

Last week, our church council approved Fix-It Saturday, and I confess I’m thrilled.

On December 5, volunteer fixers will be on hand to help with **small appliances, lamps, bikes, clothing mending, and knife sharpening**. We’ll also have a retired tech guy helping with laptops and phones. We can’t promise every item will leave working, but we’ll give it a look.

Doris Lindqvist, 84, who has darned socks for this parish since the Carter years, asked to run the mending table herself. I know better than to stand in her way.

**Everyone in the neighborhood is welcome.** It’s free, with no membership required and no sign-up. Donations to the food shelf are welcome but not expected. Please bring **one item per person to start**, so we can keep the line moving.

There will be coffee and kringle. Bring the broken toaster, yes, but stay for coffee, too. This is good neighboring, plain and simple. No strings, and nobody will preach at you.

After December, we’ll keep going on the **first Saturday of every month through spring**.

**Could you join our volunteer fixers?** We’d especially love to hear from anyone who can repair vacuums or replace zippers. If you have a knack for fixing things and a little time to share, please contact the church office.

**Questions or interested in volunteering?**  
office@stansgarlutheran.example · 612-555-0148
